Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 38 (CloudHQ VA missing-address campaign): compared this rows coordinates against the registrys other LC1 row and found it clusters geographically with the Parkway and Lockridge Road group instead, so declined to assign the well corroborated 21955 Loudoun County Parkway address to this specific ambiguous row, refreshed company history from the operators own about and founder pages, flagged a second CloudHQ name collision on Wikipedia not present in a prior sessions notes. research_status remains complete.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] CloudHQ, the data center operator, was established in 2016 by Hossein Fateh, per the operators own current about page (cloudhq.com/about/) fetched fresh this session. Fateh previously served as CEO and co-founder of DuPont Fabros Technology, a data center company that sold for 7.8 billion dollars in 2017, and has built and operated more than 700 MW of data center capacity across his career, per CloudHQs own founder page (cloudhq.com/learn-about-our-founder/), also fetched fresh this session. CloudHQ operates as part of the Fateh Family Office, alongside affiliated companies CloudCapital, WindHQ, and Dalian Development, per the operators own about page. The company maintains three regional headquarters, a global headquarters in Washington DC, an EMEA headquarters in London, and an APAC headquarters in Singapore. Per the operators own current about page, CloudHQ now describes 23 global campuses, more than 1,380 MW of contracted critical IT load with more than 6,000 MW of expansion potential, more than 30 million square feet of global data center portfolio, and more than 330 employees. A prior research pass on these rows had already flagged that the domain cloudhq.net resolves to an unrelated Google Workspace and Gmail backup software company, not this data center operator, and correctly redirected to cloudhq.com. This session found a second, separate name collision worth flagging for a future researcher: the Wikipedia article at en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CloudHQ describes yet another different, unrelated company, a cloud data synchronization tool for Google Workspace founded in 2011 by Senad Dizdar and based in San Francisco, not this Ashburn and Manassas Virginia data center operator founded by Hossein Fateh. That Wikipedia article was checked this session and found not to apply, so it is not used or cited as a source here, and no Wikipedia sourced company history is included in this reading. This specific row is one of two separate OpenStreetMap entities in this registry both named CloudHQ LC1, the other being osm:way/794147654, which this registry already records at 21955 Loudoun County Parkway, Ashburn, VA, an address independently corroborated this session by Waze driving directions, datacenterHawks dedicated LC1 Buildings A/B listing, and Baxtels own LC1A/LC1B campus table entry, three agreeing sources. This session compared coordinates to resolve which entity that well corroborated address actually belongs to. The already addressed way/794147654 sits at approximately 39.0102, -77.4627, within about half a kilometer of this registrys LC2 and LC3 rows (39.0118, -77.4625 and 39.0112, -77.4604), which independently carry Waxpool Road addresses in the same immediate area. This row, the node, instead sits at approximately 39.0054, -77.4785, roughly 1.4 kilometers south west, tightly clustered instead with this registrys LC5, LC8, LC9, LC10, LC13, and LC14 rows, the Loudoun County Parkway and Lockridge Road cluster addressed elsewhere in this batch. A single building cannot plausibly sit in both clusters at once, so this session concludes this node is most likely a duplicate or mislocated OpenStreetMap entity, not verifiably the building at 21955 Loudoun County Parkway or at any other specific address found this session. No address is asserted for this row. A future researcher revisiting OpenStreetMap source data directly, rather than this registrys mirrored coordinates, may be able to resolve which cluster, if either, this specific node actually belongs to.
